study: Summit specification-guided vs code-only unit test generation

requirements.text: A user can edit and save changes to their own comment.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 2 user story: edit own comments, save changes and see edited comments.

requirements.text: Another user must not be permitted to edit someone else’s comment.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 2 user story: edit button for comments owned by the signed-in user; Product Backlog: edit own replies.
